associated_entities.name: "Impuls" LLC
associated_entities.description: Russian limited-liability company, INN 6168033776 and OGRN 1106194004850, registered on 2010-09-27 in Rostov-on-Don. hunting_pivots.description: DriverLoader/bthcam.sys used a leaked PastDSE certificate while loading encrypted drivers in FishMonger activity. The report describes telemetry from 2023-2024; its 2026 publication date is not an observation date.

observations.context: ESET telemetry associated the DriverLoader hash with SprySOCKS for Windows activity during 2023-2024.

continuity.basis: One exact sample in a two-year telemetry range; no current file-intelligence check was performed.

hunt_queries.purpose: Find the exact DriverLoader sample and candidate filename reuse.
hunt_queries.false_positive_notes: Hash is strong; filename is weak. Validate encrypted-driver loading behavior, signer metadata and related SprySOCKS artifacts.
